description: An int reply past f64's own 2**53 integer-precision ceiling against a tiny float divisor: Python's own `multipleOf` validator falls back to `Fraction(int(instance))`, exact at any magnitude, so `1152921504606846978`'s own exact value really is a multiple of `2.7997908555096566e-301` even though the nearest f64-exact neighbour isn't.
